question: Who among the following Supreme Court judges was in news in 2022 for recusing himself from hearing a plea against the ED chief's tenure extension?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice SK Kaul.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice SK Kaul** was in news in **2022** for **recusing himself** from hearing a plea against the **ED chief's tenure extension.**
 
• The plea was filed by a lawyer who alleged that the extension granted to the ED chief was** illegal and arbitrary.**
 
• Justice Kaul** recused himself** from the case citing personal reasons.
 
• The ED chief is the head of the** Enforcement Directorate,** which is responsible for investigating **economic offenses **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice KM Joseph **was appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court in **2018.**

 
 
• He has previously served as a** Chief Justice of the Uttarakhand High Court.**
 
 
 
• **Justice Ajay Rastogi **was appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court in **2018**.
 
 
• He has previously served as a **Chief Justice of the Tripura High Court and the Rajasthan High Court.**
 
 
 
• **Justice SK Kaul** was appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court in **2018. **
 
 
• **​**He has previously served as a **Chief Justice of the Madras High Court and the Punjab and Haryana High Court.**
 
 
 
• **Justice Mukesh Shah** was appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court in** 2021.**
 
 
• **​**He has previously served as a **Chief Justice of the Patna High Court.**
